rows.itemTitle: Renewal, Termination, Transfer, and Dispute Resolution
rows.summary: 9 atomic changes. Fundamentally restructures the ancillary services contracts from separate agreements to a single Central Services Agreement with multiple program schedules. Replaces the fixed 2-year no-termination period for a required marketing agreement with a franchisor-specified 'certain date' condition, expanding franchisor discretion over schedule termination timing.

oldEvidence.quote: Franchise Agreement’s term expires 20 years after Hotel’s opening date.
1 of Service Agreement for Revenue Management Services; 10 of Subscription and Hosting Services Agreement; 1 of Field Marketing Program Opt-In Agreement

You may terminate the Service Agreement for Revenue Management Services with or without cause by providing 90 days’ written notice to us, unless we require you to sign the agreement in connection with signing the Franchise Agreement, in which case you may not terminate without cause during the first 2 years or other period we specify.
You may terminate the Field Marketing Program Opt-In Agreement

without cause on 90 days’ notice, but, if we required you to sign a Field Marketing Program Opt-In Agreement as a condition to entering into a Franchise Agreement with you, you may not terminate the Field Marketing Program Opt-In Agreement during the first 2 years of the Field Marketing Program Opt-In Agreement’s term.
We may terminate Service Agreement for Revenue Management Services if you breach your obligations under that Agreement.
No covenant not to compete, but neither you nor Hotel management company may be a Brand Owner.
Your owners may transfer non-Controlling Ownership Interests without our approval if transferee and its owners (other than a small interest public owner) are not Brand Owners or sanctioned persons
Service Agreement for Revenue Management Services is transferable only with simultaneous transfer of Franchise Agreement.
Only writing signed by duly-authorized officers may modify agreement, but we may change Hotel System, System Standards, and System Services.

newEvidence.quote: Franchise Agreement’s term expires 20 years after the 1st day of the month in which the Hotel opens.

1 of Central Services Agreement; 10 of Subscription and Hosting Services Agreement; Field Marketing Program Schedule; Central Sales Program Schedule; Revenue Management Services Program Schedule; GPGS Program Schedule; Digital Ancillary Services Program Schedule
You may terminate the Central Services Agreement upon our material breach if not cured within 10 days following receipt of notice.

You may terminate the Field Marketing Program Schedule, Central Sales Program Schedule, Revenue Management Services Program Schedule, GPGS Program Schedule, or Digital Ancillary Services Program Schedule upon our material breach if not cured within 10 days following receipt of notice or you may terminate for any reason on 90 days’ notice, but, under some circumstances, you may not terminate the applicable schedule before a certain date we specify.
We may terminate Central Services Agreement upon your material breach if not cured within 10 days following receipt of notice.
No covenant not to compete, but neither you nor Hotel management company may be a Competing Brand Owner.

Under the Franchise Agreement, your owners may transfer non-Controlling Ownership Interests without our approval if transferee and its owners (other than a small interest public owner) are not Competing Brand Owners or sanctioned persons
Central Services Agreement is transferable only to an affiliate.

Only writing signed by duly-authorized officers may modify agreement, but we may change Hotel System, System Standards, System Services, and services (and related prices) provided under the schedules to the Central Services Agreement.
